authored.name: old units are deleted by age and the rest is kept
a unit exactly at the age cutoff is deleted
a held unit is never deleted by age
over budget evicts the oldest first until it fits
equal recency is evicted in path order
units inside the guard age are reported instead of deleted
an area guard age overrides the shared one
age deletions count against the budget before eviction
a held unit over budget is reported as guarded
a zero budget evicts everything that may be
an age of zero deletes every unit that is not in the future
